assumptions: English local demo with current Chrome; no persistence or URL query contract required.
R01–R08 mapped in task order because supplied IDs have no individual descriptions.
System fonts; API fixture data/timing only, no real network service.
decisions: Single native form with stable input, polite atomic status outside busy result content, semantic cards.
Incrementing request generation guards every Promise success, catch and finally; no cancellation assumed.
New search clears earlier cards, preserves draft/focus and remains available while pending.
Retry captures the failed submitted query independently of edited input and focuses the persistent input before hiding Retry. No automatic retry loop.
Warm-paper/forest palette with CSS semantic tokens, content-driven mobile stacking and 46px+ controls.

limitations: Fixture fail always fails; Retry is verified as a fresh same-query attempt with another expected failure.
